acceptance_dimensions.silhouette_exterior_identity: Aevum purple pharmacy bands and white medical wayfinding replace ordinary retail identity while retaining a neighborhood distribution footprint
acceptance_dimensions.interior_zoning_circulation: prescription intake, refrigerated biologic vaults, controlled issue counters, rationed reserve stock and patient pickup form a compact medical supply chain
acceptance_dimensions.functional_machinery_props: dense cooler banks, sealed crates, packaged biologics and controlled dispensing stock make cold-chain dependence unavoidable
acceptance_dimensions.institutional_identity: Aevum clinical branding is overlaid by emergency allocation markings as treatment supply moves from ordinary prescription service to rationing
acceptance_dimensions.historical_damage_signature: expanding yellow reserve zones and shrinking accessible cold stock show active containment forcing treatment prioritization rather than immediate abandonment
acceptance_dimensions.narrative_evidence_loot: guaranteed supply dependence log records that thousands of patients could not safely stop APL therapy simply because infrastructure was failing
